sort: # Central offices and intergroups that serve Area 09. Only PUBLIC office or hotline numbers — never a member's personal phone. region: oc / coast / inland / desert / highdesert / online. districts: Area 09 district numbers separated by ; (write 1 & 3 for the joint district). show = no hides a row. always_open = yes when the main number is answered 24 hours. confirm = yes when a number still needs confirming.

# name / name_es, serves_en / serves_es, hours_en / hours_es = the text shown in each language. phone_label_* and phone_2_label_* say what each number is (for example 24 hours, Office). tty = a TTY line for Deaf callers. address = the office street address (opens Google Maps). verified = the date someone last checked the row; sources and notes are for editors and are not shown.
